reviews.text:
City Veterinary Care is always very responsive. Making appointments is easy. I like how I can make tech appointments for things that don't require the vet. They have a scale in the lobby so you can check on your pup's weight anytime.
Dr. Kahn and Dr. Hummel helped diagnose and manage my dog's inflammatory bowel disease. It is now very well managed!

I've had mostly good experiences at City Veterinary Care; however, I am an experienced pet owner and on alert for pushes toward needless procedures and appointments. I had one bad experience where the City Veterinary Care dentist requested an outrageously unnecessary extraction of multiple teeth during a routine cleaning. I said no to the extraction and I now go to a different vet for cleanings... where surprise...  they never saw a need for any extractions.

City Vet is still my primary vet, but they are on their second chance and they will not get a third chance.
Dr. Cloudman and her wonderful colleagues and staff have been taking care of our Kerry blue terrier for 16 years and counting...what more can I say?!
Excellent care!

My Coco (14-year old Havanese) has had some serious health issues this year, and the advice and care she has received from the doctors at City Veterinary have been life-saving.  I am so grateful to the outstanding staff from the front desk to the veterinarians.
Great vets & friendly staff who care!!

Very caring, kind, good staff, Vet Dr Lamb is named appropriately.  Ge Nile, l lovevhh,,,nn,n,n,n,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,m.    nm nnn mqq.       Zzzzzzz-z-zz-zz--zzzzzz-zzzzzzzzzzzz-zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz zzz z zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
The Vet, the techs, the assistants and staff are great - smart, thorough, kind, caring and professional.
Lovely staff and very thorough vets, what more can you ask for.

I’ve been with City Veterinary Care for many years & my pets have always received extraordinary care in every way. I’m so grateful to Dr. Kaplan for his vast knowledge, dedication & loving expertise. Also for choosing such excellent associate Vets & a truly great staff.
In my experience “City Vet” is the best!
Five star vet! Easy to make appointments, I was seen on time. Dr. Kendall was so sweet with my beagle, Harley. Grateful to have found this place!
Good care with reasonable price
Dr. Kaplan provides a thorough exam and is very clear in explaining things, which is why he has been my vet for over 20 years.

City Veterinary care are wonderful for my dog. They are thorough and caring and were able to support us during some emergencies. I now live further away and still travel to come here. They also always charge reasonably and my insurance often covers a good amount vs bondvet where the costs are rarely covered you always feel upsold.
Love the nurse and dogs and doctor and her dr lamb Justin
There is genuine care here. Highly recommend.
We love Dr. Lamb because of his personal kindness and love of animals.  Also, if you are willing to accept it, he does not push for unnecessary procedures when he knows they won't really help.
City Veterinary Care is always welcoming, accommodating and caring. Your fur baby is in the best hands. Dr.Kaplan is the best; thorough, caring, and attentive.

I love the care and personal attention City Vet and Walter‘s vet, Dr Khan, provide. Dr Khan is very thorough in her examinations and always follows up with a phone call when tests have been taken. Front desk staff is always friendly and they always run on time. Prices are on par with other quality NYC vets. Highly recommended!

I'm fostering a cat who got very ill and was told to go to City Vet. The care she has received is excellent, thorough testing with compassion. If I had know about this place I would have taken my two kitties here, despite a little travel. They also give a discount to cat rescue companies, like the one I'm fostering for. The staff has been very kind as well.

Every vet we meet at City Vet is fantastic! Scooby's usual doctor was out of town and so we saw Dr. Gallousis. She is compassionate, a great listener, and was very dedicated to finding a diagnosis and offering a solution.

The staff are excellent . Izzy gets the best care from Dr. Kaplan who is kind, attentive and always one step ahead of the game.
Recommend Drs.Lamb, Lee-Otley and Cloudman as well!
I saw Dr. Isom and Dr. Leet-Otley. Both were patient and kind with the two rescue kittens I brought, and answered my questions thoroughly. I recommend City Vet wholeheartedly.
Very professional Vet with great care and customer service.
EVERYONE is an Excellent Professional!
Incredible attention, care and facilities. Every vet at this practice has been so respectful and helpful.

I have been going to City Vet since 2005.  Sadie is my 3rd dog being cared for by Dr Andrew Kaplan, and other vets at City  Veterinary Care.   They have been extremely competent, caring, thorough, patient, and thoughtful.  I always recommend City Vet.  A friend who had a cat was told by a vet elsewhere there wasn’t anything to do to help her. I sent her to Dr Kaplan and her cat lived 4 more years! I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Professional, caring, and easy in NYC what more could you ask for. My puppy just had her spay and for start to finish an absolutely perfect experience.
Excelllent  medical care for my pets for the past 30 years-Caring,careful,responsive  and attentive. From Porcupine quill removal to emergency surgery.
I have used many vets over the years and City Vet is the best,
Visit was "on time", thorough; all questions listened-to and answered thoughtfully, carefully. Tech service was conducted with due concern for "Tannny" and completed without "objection" from her.

Dr Kaplan saved my dogs life from a serious uterus infection he performed a spay surgery At almost 14 years old she’s home recovering And doing great They have a great staff and wonderful customer care would not bring my dog anywhere else

Service went really down! They are hiring newbies doctors Dr. Alessandra Gallousis and incompetent people for front desks- Katie. I wrote to clinic manager Nicole rector who never responded back to me. They have a lot of attitude problems and entitlement. Last thing an anxious owner needs. Now they are charging 3% surcharge for credit card use but their door knob don’t even work. Yeah we are gone!

Edit: I didn’t say Dr. Gallousis was incompetent. I said the front desk is incompetent. Please learn to read. If it makes u feel better to comment on my youth than  your old age is showing too! It is too late, I’ve emailed Ms. rector on May. I gave her two months. I bet she never showed you, let alone responded to my email, hence incompetent. I felt uncomfortable with talking to Dr. gallousis, of course, I wouldn’t answer her call after her initial interaction with me. Duh!! 🙄
Great place to take your fur kiddos!

Dr Kaplan has been our Veternarian for 25 years!  He is the most compassionate  and knowledgeable  Veternarian I have ever known.   He ALWAYS  responds to emails immediately and has been there for us every step of the way.  Prices for his services have always been more than reasonable. This Saint of a man has NEVER been about money. Thank you Dr Kaplan for making us feel like family.
Really great service
Very caring & responsive Dr Cloudman
The quality of care is only surpassed by the caring and efficiency of virtually everyone at City Veterinary Care. We’ve been clients since they opened and I can’t express enough appreciation!

Caring, responsive, sensible, and committed. You'll never get a "factory" experience from this practice. As a rescue group, we tend to bring in cats in an unpredictable array of messy and perilous states. CV doesn't flinch, jumps right in. A fortunate resource for the animals and those who care for and love them.

Absolutely love how Dr. Kaplan runs his practice.  He is so caring, so involved with each an every Pet/patient. He explains everything.  I have been a client of Dr. Kaplan for over 10 yrs.  He is AMAZING 💖.  If only every Vet would care as much as he does.

City Vet is amazing. Dr. Kahn is my cat's Vet and she is just amazing. We trust her to keep Bella healthy and happy. She is, literally, the best Vet I have ever had. I cannot say enough great things about her and the practice.
We love Dr. Leet-Otley at City Vet in Manhattan!   We have had 4 kitties cared for by vets here and they have all been friendly and professional vets.  We highly recommend City Vet!

I’ve been taking my kitten here and the experience has been great. Dr. Isom is very helpful and knowledgeable. Just had a neuter surgery done here also and the whole process was really easy. Dr Kendall Leet-Otley was great calling with updates throughout the surgery.
I am so grateful to Citivet for thanking superb care of all my pets.

My cat was abused by prior owners, so she is very fearful of, and anxious around, new people.  Dr.Hummel has provided her with exemplary gentle and caring medical care for five years now.  I am so grateful.

Had an excellent visit with Dr. Kaplan who did an orthopedic exam and wellness abdominal ultra sound on my corgi peanut. He was gentle and kind and I observed the ultrasound. Very happy with the visit

My girlfriend brings her cats to this vet, and she’s very particular about who cares for her pets. She absolutely loves both the veterinarian and the staff here. Everyone is caring, professional, and genuinely attentive to the animals. You can tell they truly care about the pets they treat. Highly recommend.

My cats have been cared for by Dr. Kaplan at City Vet Care for 15 years - he has seen them through many major illnesses and whilst we lost Iggy and Zoey and Elmo, I knew that they had the best care possible. Sadie and Izzy are now in his care and I trust no vet as I do Dr. Kaplan. He is compassionate, and extremely knowledgeable. I am so grateful to have him caring for my precious furry family.
Professional and freindly service. Dr Lamb is very attentive!

We had a really good experience with City Vet after a bad one at other big chain spot. They are the best and have great table side manor when going through something difficult or you don’t understand.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Care, Cleanliness, and Compassion!
I cannot say enough good things about the incredible care my German Shepherd Gucci and I received at City Veterinary Care!!
Three days ago, my dog underwent surgery here to remove a mass/mole right below her eye. Because of the delicate location so close to her eye, I was incredibly nervous. From the moment we walked in, the clinic felt extremely clean, welcoming, and safe. The front desk staff were incredibly friendly, efficient, and helpful, making the check-in and check-out process a breeze.
Dr. Justin Lamb was absolutely wonderful. He was caring, professional, and put my mind at ease immediately. The surgery itself was a success, and he did an absolutely beautiful, precise job.

What truly sets Dr. Lamb apart is his exceptional care and communication. While she was in surgery, I was a nervous wreck, walking around, worrying, and pacing. Dr. Lamb called me personally as soon as the surgery was finished to let me know exactly how everything went and gave me clear instructions on how to care for her at home. That phone call completely put me at ease. When I told him how much I had been pacing and that I couldn't sit down, he kindly told me, "You can sit down now." That relief was everything to me!

Since coming home, I have called the clinic a few times over the last few days to ask follow-up questions. Not once did Dr. Lamb seem annoyed or rushed. Instead, he patiently answered every single one of my questions and genuinely asked how my dog was doing during each call.

Finding a vet practice that combines elite surgical skills, an immaculate facility, and a genuinely kind, patient bedside manner is rare. I received exceptional service from both the front desk and Dr. Lamb, and I highly recommend him for his outstanding care. I am so grateful for the care they showed my girl Gucci. I highly recommend City Veterinary Care to anyone looking for the best possible care for their pets!
